description_zh: 列举点播打包配置列表
kebab_example: aliyun ice list-vod-packaging-configurations --group-name vod_hls --page-size 10 --page-no 1 --sort-by desc --keyword hls --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListVodPackagingConfigurations

parameters.help_en: The name of the packaging group
parameters.name: group_name

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询每页大小，默认10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The sorting order of the packaging configurations based on the time when they were created. Valid values:

desc (default): descending order.

asc: ascending order
parameters.help_zh:
列表排序，默认 desc：
desc：按创建时间倒序排序；
asc：按创建时间正序排序
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en: The search keyword. The names of the returned packaging configurations contain the keyword
parameters.help_zh: 搜索关键词，列举查询点播打包配置名称包含该关键词的打包配置列表
parameters.name: keyword
